name: Context.dev Launch Film (YC S26)
text: A launch film for Context.dev, showing how it turns the internet into an API so AI agents can access clean, structured, and up-to-date web data.

name: Tsenta Launch Film (YC S26)
text: A founder-led launch film for Tsenta, showing how its founders turned their own broken job-search experience into a platform that helps thousands of people find roles and land interviews.

name: Agnost Launch Film (YC S26)
text: A launch film for Agnost AI, showing how it turns user conversations into product insights and automatically fixes what’s broken

name: Rage Prompt
text: A high-energy launch film for Agnost AI, showing how angry user prompts become the most honest feedback an AI agent can get.

name: Agglayer Summit
text: A satirical campaign film for Agglayer Summit at Devcon Thailand 2024, centered on the idea of different chains coexisting with each other.

name: Agnost AI
text: A launch film for Agnost AI on language as the new interface, and the infrastructure making AI agents that actually understand what users want.
